summary: 64-bit left-shift helper identified by the ABI record as the CRT ___allshl routine. Shifts the 64-bit value a1 (edx:eax) left by the count a2 (cl): a count of at least 0x40 yields a zero result, a count in [0x20, 0x40) zeroes the low 32 bits of the result, and a smaller count returns a1 shifted by (a2 & 0x1F). Invoked by sub_58E4D2 as the 64-bit shift helper.

operations.description: If the shift count a2 is at least 0x40 the shift is out of range and the result is zero.
Else if a2 is at least 0x20, only the low 32 bits of the result are zeroed (LODWORD(v2) = 0); the decompiled text shows no high-word assignment on this path.
For a count below 0x20 the value is shifted by (a2 & 0x1F): a1 << (a2 & 0x1F).
Return v2 on the count >= 0x20 paths; the ABI record identifies the routine as CRT ___allshl.
Invoked by sub_58E4D2 (0x0058E4D2) as the 64-bit left-shift helper.
